immutable_observation.rule: Diagnosis may explain this observation but must never amend, relabel, suppress, recompute, or overwrite the first-complete result.

layer_1_inputs.rule: Start from the exact archived first-complete ZIP. Do not consult mutation truth, operator metadata, expected E2 predictions, candidate-58, epistemic-10, or raw blind-58 transport.

layer_2_selected_source_rule.scope: Only the exact frozen selected-48 source Git blobs already read by the first-complete hosted execution may be inspected.

strict_transport_eligibility.definition: A row is transport-eligible only when case_transport_status is COMPLETE, parser_status is PASS, exactly one guard anchor exists and is role-compatible, and exactly one effect anchor exists and is role-compatible.

taxonomy.D0_EXPECTED_TRANSPORT_CONSERVATIVE_REJEC: Strict frozen transport eligibility is false; adapter correctly emits the existing fail-closed incomplete-transport row. This is not by itself a v0.3 scientific frontend failure.
taxonomy.D1_TRANSPORT_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: Frozen transport output is internally inconsistent with its own frozen contract or exact selected source/anchor authorities.
taxonomy.D2_BASE_IR_OR_LANGUAGE_FRONTEND_LIMITATI: Transport is eligible but the frozen v0.3 IR/frontend cannot construct the required base IR surface.
taxonomy.D3_ANCHOR_USABILITY_OR_OVERLAY_LIMITATIO: Transport is eligible and base IR succeeds, but transported anchors cannot be safely bound into the frozen observability overlay.
taxonomy.D4_CONTROL_GUARD_LINKAGE_LIMITATION: Transport and overlay succeed but complete control scope/effective guard observability fails.
taxonomy.D5_PATH_EFFECT_DATAFLOW_LIMITATION: Transport/control prerequisites succeed but path-level dataflow, effect-surface uniqueness, ordering/outcome, representation closure, or witness-precondition observability fails.
taxonomy.D6_CHECKER_DISAGREEMENT: Primary and Independent disagree on the canonical row or diagnosis-relevant frozen fields.
taxonomy.D7_UNRESOLVED_WITH_FROZEN_EVIDENCE: Available frozen evidence is insufficient for a narrower classification without consulting forbidden information.

next_boundary: After the diagnosis report is immutably frozen, decide separately whether the five-or-more transport-eligible nonqualified rows justify a new scientific remediation experiment. Do not authorize candidate-58 merely because diagnosis is complete.
